title: Large language model detects previously undiagnosed heart failure with preserved ejection fraction in patients with metabolic-associated fatty liver disease: A multicenter cohort study.
summary: MedGuide-14B applied to multicenter MAFLD EHRs identified additional HFpEF cases; blinded cardiologist review and longitudinal outcomes support the result, with retrospective design limits.
ai_technology: domain-tuned MedGuide-14B analyzed structured and free-text EHR data at three hospitals; 24,011 patients, 4,226 newly model-identified cases, and blinded cardiologist confirmation in 452/500 reviewed. Retrospective cohort; no prospective clinical-utility test.
